brief: blind judge on reports/packs/prose-tics-r4/ (quality question, both sides masked)
procedure_declared_before_reading: 1. Read AGENT-PROTOCOL, RI-MTH03, pack README, one PROMPT.md, all 15 pack.json. Confirm no mapping inside pack.

2. For each trial t01..t15 in order, read ONLY A.txt and B.txt. Decide from words alone: PICK, CONFIDENCE, 3-6 quoted evidence bullets, WEAKEST POINT. Write answer.md into the trial dir immediately (protocol rule 2: write as soon as ready).

3. Decision rule I commit to in advance: the shipped-game side should show (a) concrete, unglamorous specificity a writer needed for the world to work - prices, dates, procedures, names of offices; (b) a speaker with an agenda, bias or error, not a neutral narrator; (c) irregular rhythm and sentence length, including bad/awkward sentences; (d) content that does not resolve tidily. The placeholder side should show even paragraphing, balanced clause pairs, summary rather than incident, and thematic closure.
4. After all 15 answer.md exist, concatenate them, record sha256 of the bundle AND per-file sha256, write those into the verdict BEFORE opening ../prose-tics-r4.reveal/mapping.json.
5. Unblind, score, report accuracy per register.
6. THEN run a structural leak audit (byte-level, punctuation inventory, whitespace, word-count asymmetry, vocabulary overlap) and report anything found.
7. Write verdict .md + .json, append one line to reports/blog-feed.jsonl. No prose edits, no commits.
contamination_note: While confirming pack.json carries no mapping I necessarily saw a_words/b_words. I did NOT use them to decide any trial; I will state per-trial whether my pick agrees with the word-count asymmetry so the reader can discount if they wish.
findings: PACK STRUCTURE OK: reveal dir is a sibling (reports/packs/prose-tics-r4.reveal/), pack dirs contain only A.txt B.txt PROMPT.md pack.json. No answer.md pre-existing => pack is unanswered.

PROMPT.md of t01 points the judge at '../prose-tics-r2.reveal/' - a stale path; the real reveal dir is prose-tics-r4.reveal. Cosmetic, but it means the prompt was copied from the superseded r3/r2 pack.

SUSPECTED LEAK (not used to answer, to be confirmed post-unblind): in pack.json word counts, A > B in all 5 books trials; B > A in all 4 non-tied dialogue trials. If side assignment were per-trial random this pattern is ~1/32 x 1/16. Suggests side is constant within a register and that the length-matching trim is asymmetric.
next_step: read t01-books A.txt and B.txt; answer; then t02..t15
notes_for_successor: FORBIDDEN READS (contamination): corpus/90-verdicts/wave1/W1-PROSE-BLIND-r1.md, orchestration/status/W1-PROSE-R2.json, orchestration/status/W1-PROSE-TICS.json, tools/check-prose.mjs, mapping.json until step 4 done. Do not edit prose. Do not commit.
